info.name: Wind forecast API checks
info.description: Happy paths, validation, routing, headers, rate limiting and caching for the read-only API. Choose the 'local' or 'production' environment.

exec: pm.test("uses the 07:30 run before the 09:00 cutoff", () => pm.expect(b.runs_used[0].publish_time).to.eql("2026-01-27T07:30:00Z"));

item.name: Hostile origin gets no CORS permission

request.description: Some Postman setups ignore a custom Host header. If this request does not reach the server with the changed Host, skip it.

exec: pm.test("rejected as an invalid host", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql("invalid_host"); });

item.name: Burst request: run this folder with 150 iterations

request.description: Default limit is 120 requests per minute per client. For a faster demo start the server with RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN=20 and run 40 iterations. Expect 200s, then 429s.
